newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.168 bln stg week to May 14.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.168 bln stg week to May 14.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.168 billion stg in the week to May 14 from 25.205 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 fell to 25.000 billion stg from 25.429 billion the week before.

Notes and coins in circulation were virtually unchanged on a seaonsally adjusted basis at 25.086 billion stg compared with 25.085 billion. Unadjusted notes and coins dropped to 24.918 billion stg from 25.309 billion.
